purpose: Generated candidates for the Station Dock and arrival moment in art/concept-station/dock/brief-dock.md; concept art awaiting the owner's choice, not captures and not authored masters.

tool.name: Gemini API
tool.auth: API key from the environment; not recorded

models.gemini-3-pro-image: Gemini 3 Pro Image: final candidates and refinements

tool.modelChoice: Pro for edits of the approved Home and for fresh generations needing exact strings; one Flash fresh generation in round 1 for comparison.
tool.output: image/jpeg 2752x1536 (16:9 at 2K), kept byte-exact in raw/ for kept candidates; LANCZOS to 1536x864 as the canvas PNG; the screen PNG is the centred 1024:600 band resampled to 1024x600. Composites made by rectangle from region edits are recorded in their own JSON beside the file.
tool.imageInputs: Sent as inline image parts, each preceded by a short text part stating its role; the preamble, then the prompt verbatim as the last text part.
tool.budget: At most 20 generations for this screen; 10 used (round 1: 4, round 2: 3, round 3: 3), 1 on gemini-3.1-flash-image and 9 on gemini-3-pro-image. No call failed; none was retried. Two composites (D-C1, D-C2) were made by rectangle without generation.

references.art/concept-station/round3/A-r3-a1-1024x: approved Station Home concept: the screen this moment plays on; edit target for region edits
references.art/concept-homepage/hero-kit.png: the kit render: the Companion handheld to seat in the dock
references.art/miniature-lives/assets/rich-plain-30: accepted rich Pip; Dot is the same species asleep
references.art/concept-station/dock/layout/dock-lay: layout truth only: notes-free flat boxes at 1024x600

directions.A arrival-edit: Four-change edits of the approved Home (rejected: edits of that size re-render the screen).
directions.B arrival-fresh: Fresh generations with the approved Home as composition reference and the kit render for the Companion.
directions.E region-edit (round 2): Single-module edits of the approved Home (bay and rack; Probe dock), composited back by rectangle so the vivarium stays pixel-exact.

plan.vibe: Owner, 2026-10-07: the overview (Home's frame, Dock and arrival) keeps the industrial, plasticky hardware design of A-r3-a1.
plan.rounds: Round 1: two edits and two fresh. Round 2: a three-change edit of the near-pass plus two region edits for a composite. Round 3 only for a near-pass one change would fix.

calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Miniature Beasts Station HOME screen, 16:9, flat screen design filling the canvas. Edit the supplied screen (Image 1) and preserve every other pixel: the layout, the slate bezel and module column, the vivarium's plants, rocks, pool, burrow, moss and light, Pip exactly as drawn with its ring and plate, the glowtail, the puffcap, the Incubation module, the bottom line's layout, every status lamp.
FOUR CHANGES ONLY: (1) The SAMPLE BAY module: its door is open and a cool blue-white beam lights the inside; the left crate's lid is open with its orange seal tag broken, the right crate still sealed with its tag; a short slate rail runs from the bay's lower-left corner down to the POD RACK, and one small amber-brown seed-pod travels along it mid-way while another has just seated in the rack's fourth well, so the rack reads four pods (green, blue, violet, amber-brown) and two empty wells, exactly six wells in one row. (2) The PROBE DOCK module: the Companion handheld from Image 2 sits upright in the cradle, screen dark, about 110 px tall, its orange Confirm visible; the module's lamp is green; the three Shield plates beside it show two lit cream and one dark. (3) The frosted-glass nest in the vivarium's lower right now holds Dot, a second hopper of exactly Pip's species and colours, slightly smaller, curled asleep, eyes closed. (4) Replace the top bar's right text with "Companion docked · 2 crates", draw the three counters slightly brighter, and add a slim slate ribbon across the top edge of the stage, over the vivarium's top bezel, reading "Expedition 4 home · 2 pods" in cream; the bottom line reads orange "✓ Look at the new pods", grey "the room", grey "arrival playing".
TEXT, exactly these and nothing else: top bar left "Home  T5"; top bar centre a yellow lightning bolt "9", a blue diamond "4", a green drop "6", drawn slightly brighter as if ticking; top bar right "Companion docked · 2 crates". A slim slate ribbon across the top of the stage reads "Expedition 4 home · 2 pods". On the small plate under Pip "Pip" and "hopper · adult". Module words, engraved and quiet: "Sample bay", "Pod rack", "Incubation", "Probe dock". Bottom line: orange "✓ Look at the new pods" at left, grey "the room" in the middle, grey "arrival playing" at right.
Constraints: nothing of the field: no map, no landscape, no extra counters; no tables, title bars, bullet lists, progress bars, boxed buttons or digits on the bench; no logos; no creatures other than Pip, the glowtail, the puffcap and Dot asleep; no people.
calls.preamble: Reference images follow; their roles are stated. Image 1 is the screen to edit. Image 2 is the kit render: take only the Companion handheld from it. Image 3 is the accepted rich Pip, already in Image 1; keep it, and draw Dot as the same species asleep.

imageInputs.role: edit target: the approved Home screen
the kit render: take only the Companion handheld from it to seat in the dock
accepted rich Pip: keep Pip unchanged; Dot is the same species asleep

original.note: Original JPEG not stored to limit repository size (rejected candidate); the PNGs are LANCZOS resamples of it and its SHA-256 is recorded.

result.disposition: rejected (four-change edit re-rendered the whole screen: vivarium gone, a cat in a glass jar, purple diamond)

calls.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Miniature Beasts Station HOME screen during DOCK AND ARRIVAL, a flat screen design that fills the whole 16:9 canvas edge to edge (the outer 2 percent at left and right is bleed, trimmed later to 1024x600). Not a device photograph: no bezel, no buttons, no hands. Design at 1024x600 first.
STYLE: exactly the approved Station Home screen supplied as Image 1: the same chrome, module column, vivarium, light and smooth type, so this reads as the same device a moment later. One key light from the upper left, clean painted light, crisp edges, no noise or dither. The vivarium is the only warm light; the chrome is cool; the bay's inner beam is cool blue-white. Labels are one small engraved word, low contrast, read second. No wood, no felt, no lamp fixture.
LAYOUT, as the supplied Home screen and template: top bar, the bevelled vivarium window on the left two thirds, the column of four slate modules on the right third, bottom line. THE MOMENT: the Companion has docked and the player has opened the bay. SAMPLE BAY module: door open, a cool blue-white beam inside, two slate-and-teal crates with orange seal tags, the left one open with its tag broken, the right one still sealed with a small place stamp; a short slate rail curves from the bay down to the POD RACK, one small amber-brown seed-pod travelling along it, another just seated, so the rack shows exactly six wells in one row with four pods (green, blue, violet, amber-brown) and two empty. INCUBATION module unchanged: a glass dome with a glowing green embryo and a ring of five leaves, two bright. PROBE DOCK module: the Companion handheld from the kit render seated upright in the cradle, screen dark, about 110 px tall, orange Confirm visible, the module lamp green, three Shield plates beside it, two lit cream and one dark. A slim slate RIBBON crosses the top edge of the stage over the vivarium's bezel. In the VIVARIUM, the same habitat as the Home screen in warm daylight: Pip, exactly the supplied rich Pip, at the centre on moss inside a thin cream ring, head turned toward the bay at the right, its small plate under it; the glowtail at the left and the puffcap mibi at the right also looking toward the bay; the frosted-glass nest at the lower right now holds Dot, a second hopper of Pip's species and colours, slightly smaller, curled asleep.
TEXT, exactly these and nothing else: top bar left "Home  T5"; top bar centre a yellow lightning bolt "9", a blue diamond "4", a green drop "6", drawn slightly brighter as if ticking; top bar right "Companion docked · 2 crates". A slim slate ribbon across the top of the stage reads "Expedition 4 home · 2 pods". On the small plate under Pip "Pip" and "hopper · adult". Module words, engraved and quiet: "Sample bay", "Pod rack", "Incubation", "Probe dock". Bottom line: orange "✓ Look at the new pods" at left, grey "the room" in the middle, grey "arrival playing" at right.
Constraints: nothing of the field: no map, no landscape, no extra counters; no tables, title bars, bullet lists, progress bars, boxed buttons or digits on the bench; no logos; no creatures other than Pip, the glowtail, the puffcap and Dot asleep; no people.
calls.preamble: Reference images follow; their roles are stated. Image 1 is the approved Station Home screen: this is the same screen a moment later; keep everything of it that the prompt does not change. Image 2 is the kit render: take only the Companion handheld from it, to sit in the dock. Image 3 is the accepted rich Pip; keep Pip exactly, and draw Dot as the same species asleep. Image 4 is layout truth only: the boxes and labels show where each element sits at 1024x600; it is not a style reference.
